describe: The image shows a painted daytime sky. Pale blue-grey haze covers the upper area, with soft cream and pale yellow cloud masses rising in the centre and to the left. Along the bottom, a dark olive-green treeline with a large rounded tree crown sits on a hazy green-grey band. Lighting is soft and diffuse, with low contrast and a faint speckled, aged grain. Keep the cloud shapes and the treeline in their current positions.
